tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page night. The ground under every surface; text tokens hold AA on it.

tokens.name: bg-vignette
tokens.usage: Centre of the page's radial vignette (radial-gradient from here to `bg`).

tokens.name: bg-deep
tokens.usage: Living Web: the 3D scene's outer ground and the corner of the device vignette.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and panels on solid pages.

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: Conductor: hover and selected fills one lift above `surface`; assistant bubbles, the composer field.

tokens.name: surface-strong
tokens.usage: Conductor: the second lift, for pressed or active fills.

tokens.name: surface-veil
tokens.usage: Cards floating over the web background.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Living Web: the text panel over the 3D scene, always with a 14px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: frost-soft
tokens.usage: Conductor: the frosted composer strip.

tokens.name: silk
tokens.usage: Web strands and secondary body text. Conductor body copy on `bg`, `surface` and `glass`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-soft` and `glass`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, timestamps, the ledger, queued steps. On `bg`, `surface` and `glass`.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: The accent: hover, focus outline, active and running state, Conductor's acknowledgement line. Text on `bg`, `surface`, `glass`.

tokens.name: on-glow
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `glow` fill (pressed segment, selected view).

tokens.name: silk-border
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on cards, panels, chips and controls.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Conductor: dashed outlines (delegate-call list) and stronger dividers.

tokens.name: silk-strong
tokens.usage: Emphasised strands and dividers that must read at a glance.

tokens.name: glow-soft
tokens.usage: The glow halo: `shadow-glow`, running-state fills.

tokens.name: glow-faint
tokens.usage: Living Web: the current moment chip and other selected-but-quiet fills.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Conductor's existing composer focus ring. Below 3:1 on `surface-soft`: new work uses a solid `glow` outline instead.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Done, found, created: receipts and the done pill. Text on `bg`, `surface`, `glass`; fill under `on-status` text.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Receipt and finished-note fills under `ok` text.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Waiting on you: confirmations, questions, the amber strand. Text on `bg`, `surface`, `glass`; fill under `on-status` text.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Confirmation and question card fills.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed steps and errors, always with the word. Text on `bg`, `surface`, `glass`.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Failed-step and error fills.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Conductor's own voice in the existing chat: the avatar, delegate-call icons.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Avatar disc behind the Conductor mark.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Your message bubble in the chat view.

tokens.name: info-border
tokens.usage: Border of your message bubble.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Step kinds (recall, ask, look) in mono, and memory facts.

tokens.name: violet-soft
tokens.usage: Memory-fact chip fill.

tokens.name: on-status
tokens.usage: Text on solid `ok`, `warn` or `glow` fills (the done pill, the primary confirm button).

tokens.name: warden-accent
tokens.usage: Glitch (Warden): the circuit traces and eye rings. 3D only, never text.

tokens.name: icon-pawn
tokens.usage: Chess anchor: the white pawn. 3D material colour, outlined in `icon-outline-dark`.

tokens.name: icon-note
tokens.usage: Music anchor: the black eighth note. 3D material colour, outlined in `icon-outline-light`.

tokens.name: icon-check
tokens.usage: PCC anchor: the green check, with emissive `icon-check-glow`.

tokens.name: icon-check-glow
tokens.usage: Emissive colour of the PCC check (0.55, 0.88 when its step is done).

tokens.name: icon-outline-dark
tokens.usage: Inverted-hull outline on the pawn and the check.

tokens.name: icon-outline-light
tokens.usage: Inverted-hull outline on the black note.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Uppercase, with a matching text-indent to re-centre. Page titles only, in `ink`.

styles.name: room-said
styles.sample: Find the album Maya sent last week.
styles.usage: Room / wall: what you said, at about three times desk size; readable from 4 m. Container-relative.

styles.name: said
styles.sample: Find the album Maya sent last week, download it, and put it on my list for Saturday.
styles.usage: What you said, at the top of the panel, in `ink` (16px on phone).

styles.name: narration
styles.sample: Found it: Low Tide Atlas by Kessler Row.
styles.usage: Conductor's spoken reply, in `ink` (15px on phone).

styles.name: said-again
styles.usage: A short follow-up you said (a yes), in `silk`.

styles.name: ack
styles.sample: On it. Checking last week, then asking music and PCC.
styles.usage: Conductor's one-line acknowledgement of the plan, in `glow`.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Here are the three tracks you skipped most.
styles.usage: Chat bubbles (0.92rem), cards and buttons, in `silk` or `ink`.

styles.name: step
styles.usage: Plan step titles, receipts, card text.

styles.name: pill
styles.usage: Status pills: the status as a word.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels (You, Conductor, Ledger), in `muted`.

styles.name: kind
styles.usage: Step kinds in `violet`; app names; refs.

styles.name: ledger
styles.usage: Ledger lines and the HUD (clock, fps), in `muted`; the newest line in `ink`.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow over a page title, in `muted`.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside a pill; HUD chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between steps, receipts and chips in a list.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside cards and between buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Step and receipt padding (8px 10px); chat gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between panel sections; card padding (12px).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Confirmation-card padding; phone panel padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Panel inset from the scene edge; page gutter minimum.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop panel padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: HUD chips.

tokens.name: radius-step
tokens.usage: Plan steps, receipts, confirm buttons.

tokens.name: radius-chat
tokens.usage: Conductor's composer field, send and mic buttons.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Night-Silk's card radius: cards, job card, note, confirmation, segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-bubble
tokens.usage: Chat bubbles (the corner nearest the speaker drops to 4px).

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: The glass panel and the 3D device frame (22px as a phone sheet).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and moment chips.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Night-Silk hover: with a `glow` border and a 2px lift.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: Conductor: floating panels and menus.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Conductor: raised cards.

duration.note: Motion timings from the Living Web prototype. Reduced motion collapses every one to an instant change.

tokens.name: dur-receipt
tokens.usage: A receipt's arrival: the strand's last 20% draws and the anchor turns green.

tokens.name: dur-receipt-travel
tokens.usage: The receipt packet running home along the strand.

tokens.name: dur-queue-stagger
tokens.usage: Each queued strand starts 300ms after the one before.

tokens.name: dur-panel-fade
tokens.usage: The panel fading out and in for voice-only.

tokens.name: dur-scene-fade
tokens.usage: The scene dimming for voice-only; the canvas fading in once ready.

tokens.name: dur-wait-pulse
tokens.usage: One amber pulse of a waiting anchor.

tokens.name: dur-hover
tokens.usage: Night-Silk hover lift and glow.

tokens.name: dur-ring
tokens.usage: A listening or receipt ring expanding from Glitch.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Things arriving: a receipt, a panel card.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Fades: voice-only, the canvas, panel opacity.

scene.note: Values the 3D scene is built to. World units are the web's; the web sits in the z = 0 plane.

tokens.name: web-radius
tokens.usage: Distance from the hub to an app anchor.

tokens.name: web-spokes
tokens.usage: Radial threads, irregularly spaced from a fixed seed.

tokens.name: web-spiral-turns
tokens.usage: Capture-spiral turns on desktop and room; 16 on phones.

tokens.name: strand-pending-reach
tokens.usage: How far a strand reaches before its receipt. Only a receipt draws the rest.

tokens.name: glitch-max-rate
tokens.usage: Glitch's error flicker, in flashes per second; never more.

tokens.name: camera-fov
tokens.usage: Camera field of view in degrees.

tokens.name: dpr-cap-desktop
tokens.usage: Device-pixel-ratio cap on desktop and room.

tokens.name: dpr-cap-phone
tokens.usage: Device-pixel-ratio cap on phones, which also drop MSAA and half the dust.

tokens.name: icon-scale
tokens.usage: App icons, in front of the web at z 0.24 so threads never show through.
